desc:
BATCHABLES BROWNIE MIX: Make small batches of individual brownies with Betty Crocker Batchables Fudge Brownie Mix

CHOOSE THE AMOUNT: You can make anywhere from four to 12 muffin-sized brownies per batch, or make an 8"x8" pan

ADD MILK OR WATER: You can whip up delicious brownie mix in no time by simply adding milk or water

PERFECT FOR SNACKING: Bake up a small batch of fudge brownies for a yummy afternoon snack with none leftover; Try other Betty Crocker Batchables for easy desserts, including chocolate chip cookies and blueberry muffins

CONTAINS: 29.5 oz
features:
Key Features:

Flexible Batch Size

Make as few as 4 brownies or as many as 12, or even a full 8x8-inch pan—your choice each time.

Large Tub (29.5 oz)

Comes in a resealable tub with enough mix for multiple small batches over time.

Just Add Milk or Water

No eggs or oil needed. Easy to prepare with ingredients you likely already have.

Rich Fudge Brownie Flavor

Made with cocoa processed with alkali for a deep, chocolatey taste.

Quick Bake Time

Ready in about 22 to 28 minutes whether you’re using a muffin tin, toaster oven, or traditional pan.

Supports Box Tops for Education

Every purchase helps support schools through this program.

Simple Ingredients

Includes sugar, enriched wheat flour, palm oil, and cocoa. Contains wheat and egg ingredients.

Benefits:

Bake What You Need

No wasted brownies or leftovers—perfect for small households or portion control.Time-Saving

Quick prep and fast baking mean homemade brownies anytime, even on busy days.

Great for All Occasions

Perfect for solo snacks, movie nights, last-minute guests, or after-school treats.

Bakery Taste at Home

Gooey, rich, and indulgent flavor without bakery prices.

Kid-Friendly

Simple steps make it ideal for kids to help with baking.

Minimal Cleanup

No need to handle messy oils or crack eggs—just mix and bake.
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Palm Oil, Cocoa Processed with Alkali. Contains 2% or less of: Corn Starch, Eggs with Sodium Silicoaluminate, Salt, Artificial Flavor.
